listeners.doc: Connects to the configured Azure Service Bus entity and dispatches each delivered message to the attached service.

serviceTypes.doc: Consumes messages delivered from the queue, topic, or subscription configured on the listener.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked once per message delivered from the queue, topic, or subscription configured on the listener. The entity to consume from and the receive mode (RECEIVE_AND_DELETE or PEEK_LOCK) are configured on the listener's init config, not on the service.

params.name: message
params.doc: The delivered message. Declare a narrower type to project the body, see the messageBody data-binding rule.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for explicitly completing, abandoning, deferring, or dead-lettering the message via its lock token. Needed only when the listener's receiveMode is PEEK_LOCK and autoComplete is disabled; under RECEIVE_AND_DELETE the message is already removed from the entity on retrieval, and with autoComplete enabled the listener settles it automatically.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when a message cannot be retrieved from the subscribed entity or cannot be dispatched, most commonly because a delivered message's body fails to bind to the declared parameter type.

params.name: 'error
params.doc: The failure that prevented the message from being delivered.
